---
name: test-driven-development
description: Structure a code change around observable failing and passing tests.
status: published
---

## When to Use

Use for a behaviour change that can be expressed as an automated test.

## Procedure

1. State the expected behaviour.
2. Add a focused regression test and observe its failure.
3. Make the smallest implementation change that satisfies the test.
4. Run the relevant wider checks.

## Verification

- Record the failing and passing commands and outcomes.
